name: Chosen Foods 100% Pure Avocado Oil (High Heat Cooking Oil)
whyItWorks: Naturally refined without chemicals, boasting a 500°F smoke point and rich heart-healthy monounsaturated oleic acid. Unlike industrial seed oils (corn, soybean, canola), it does not generate toxic inflammatory lipid peroxides when heated.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use 1 teaspoon to pan-sear lean chicken cutlets, white fish fillets, or zucchini rounds in a nonstick skillet.
